finalReading.passage: When Leo first tried to paint, his pictures looked dull and he almost gave up. Then his teacher told him to stop copying others and to look closely at his own everyday life instead. A month later, a simple drawing of his grandmother's hands won first prize, and Leo finally understood that real inspiration was right in front of him all along.

questions.q: What advice did Leo's teacher give him?
options: To watch his own daily life instead of imitating others.
To buy more expensive paints and brushes.
To copy famous works more carefully.
questions.explanation: 原文 'stop copying others and to look closely at his own everyday life' 的转述;其余与原文相反或未提。
